scope: GAP-INGEST-001 image-set coherence. Every admitted page of the same report contributes to one coherent assessment in upload order; an exact duplicate is skipped rather than double-counted; distinct bureau reports and reference dates stay in separate groups with their own provenance; and no record borrows a fact from another file. Implementation is closed by ah-multifile-assessment + bb-gap-ingest-001; staging verification is pending.

tests.expected: two pages contribute one record each in upload order; a later-page fact is named in the generated report; reordering preserves the same evaluated facts/checks; a duplicate adds no record or finding; distinct bureaus and conflicting readings stay separate; the real endpoints upload, evaluate, view and isolate the assembled case
tests.measured: 39/39 assertions pass: files_included 2, records [1,2], both printed dates reach the consumer result, later-page date 07/15/2026 named in the report, reordering keeps the same examined dates + record facts + checks_performed, duplicate adds no checks or examined facts, two bureau groups, conflicting readings stay two records, HTTP upload 201 + evaluate 201 + view 200 (two files, both facts) + cross-account 403

tests.expected: the shared assembly foundation: both files examined, no fact borrowing, exact duplicate not double-counted, distinct bureaus and dates kept apart, missing pages flagged only when numbering is printed
tests.measured: 66/66 assertions pass across the unit assembly cases (two files, duplicate, mixed bureaus, two dates, dedupe pages, missing pages, continuation merge) and an HTTP upload + evaluate journey with both assembled file_ids recorded

staging_verification.reason: no current-release HTTP journey evidence recorded for an admitted multi-file upload; implementation is closed by the behavioral tests, but the deployed journey and production readiness remain unresolved until a current-release, served build is measured.
